draft.subject: Quick help finishing setup in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Sorry we missed each other last week — no problem at all. I saw you created your first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

The usual next step from there is bringing in a teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that next step with you and answer anything about how Quartz Collective is using Wrenfield.

Best,
Nadia
